detail.longDescription: I posit that: 1. I am faster using agentic coding than without 2. I am 10x faster using many agents in parallel 3. When I hit a limit (5h, week), its a good time to take a break - and focus on some slower work or step away. 4. If I can reliably produce quality output with agents, then I should attempt to automate the workflow from idea to QA. 5. If I can automate how I work, I can sleep while I work. 6. If I can sleep when I work, I can get more done, while working less. 7. If I can token max while retaining and continually improving the process and output quality, I can work less and earn more.
